name: Disarming Mixture
summary: Disarming Mixture is a specialized chemical concoction prepared by Chief Engineer Hinderweir at the Stonewrought Dam. Created to neutralize volatile Seaforium explosives, it is used to prevent Dark Iron saboteurs from destroying the massive dwarven structure holding back the waters of Loch Modan.

sections.title: A Chemical Neutralizer
sections.body: When Dark Iron saboteurs planted a heavy Seaforium charge beneath the foundation of the Stonewrought Dam, standard methods of defusal were far too risky. Lacking immediate Mountaineer support, Chief Engineer Hinderweir combined the Disarming Mixture from ingredients named by the explosives expert Ashlan Stonesmirk to rapidly neutralize the underwater explosive. When stirred directly into the planted powder keg, the solution neutralizes the reactive compounds, reducing a catastrophic explosion to a harmless, fizzling ruin.

faq.q: What is the Disarming Mixture used for?
faq.answer: The mixture is formulated to neutralize a large Seaforium explosive keg planted underwater at the foundation of the Stonewrought Dam by Dark Iron insurgents.
Chief Engineer Hinderweir, the dwarven engineer overseeing maintenance and defense at the Stonewrought Dam, blends the necessary ingredients to create the mixture.

faq.q: Why was the mixture necessary instead of simply disarming the bomb?
aliases: why use chemicals on the bomb
faq.answer: Seaforium powder is harmless while dry, but once wet it can explode with tremendous force. The chemical mixture neutralizes the reactive powder inside the keg directly, eliminating the blast hazard while submerged beneath the dam.

angles.text: The Disarming Mixture demonstrates practical counter-engineering, relying on rapid chemical neutralization to render volatile Seaforium charges harmless without triggering detonation.
Preserving the Stonewrought Dam is vital to protecting the surrounding valleys and lowlands, making the swift application of this neutralizer critical to dwarven security.
